# Background

Adoptive transfer of antigen-specific T and B cells followed by subcutaneous immunisation.
Tissue: draining lymph nodes. Sampling days: Day 0, 2, 4, 6.

**Input:** Cell Ranger output per sample (`<input>/<Day>/`, filtered feature-barcode matrices)
**Output:**

* `RDS_initial_Seurat_scTfh23.rds` – merged, unfiltered object
* `RDS_integrated_Seurat_scTfh23.rds` – filtered and integrated object
* `RDS_integrated_Seurat_SCE_scTfh23.RData` – SingleCellExperiment for doublet detection (`02_doublet_detection.R`)

Next: `02_doublet_detection.R`, then `03_clustering_TB_annotation.Rmd`.

# Setup

Conda environment: *Seurat_toolbox2*.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4)
```

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(foreach)
library(Matrix)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r paths}
project <- "scTfh23"
input   <- "../data/01_Counts/"
rdata   <- "../RData/"
results <- "../results/"

# 1 = recompute from the count matrices / rerun the integration, 0 = load saved objects
recalculate_switch      <- 0
recalculate_integration <- 0

color_vector_samples <- c(
  "Day0" = "#fdb863",
  "Day2" = "#e66101",
  "Day4" = "#b2abd2",
  "Day6" = "#54009E")
```

# Read in the count data

Basic prefiltering: genes detected in ≥ 3 cells, cells with ≥ 200 detected genes.
The antibody-capture (ADT) counts are stored as a second assay.

```{r sample-read-in}
if (recalculate_switch == 1) {
  which_samples <- list.dirs(input, recursive = FALSE)

  list_seurat <- foreach(i = as.character(which_samples), .packages = c("Matrix", "Seurat")) %dopar% {
    seurat.data <- Read10X(data.dir = i)
    rownames(seurat.data[["Antibody Capture"]]) <- gsub(pattern = "*_TotalSeqC", replacement = "",
                                                         x = rownames(seurat.data[["Antibody Capture"]]))
    obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = seurat.data[["Gene Expression"]],
                              project = gsub(i, pattern = paste0(input, "/"), replacement = ""),
                              min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
    obj[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(seurat.data[["Antibody Capture"]][, colnames(obj)])
    obj
  }

  # merge all samples
  seurat.Tfh <- reduce(list_seurat, merge)
  saveRDS(seurat.Tfh, file = paste0(rdata, "RDS_initial_Seurat_", project, ".rds"))
} else {
  seurat.Tfh <- readRDS(paste0(rdata, "RDS_initial_Seurat_", project, ".rds"))
}

table(seurat.Tfh$orig.ident)
```

Cell numbers differ between samples (Day 2 ≈ 6× more cells than Day 6, Day 4 ≈ 2×); sequencing saturation
(Cell Ranger summary) was lowest for Day 2.

# Cell QC

```{r qc-metrics, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "QC metrics per sample before filtering."}
seurat.Tfh[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.Tfh, pattern = "^mt-")
seurat.Tfh[["percent.rb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.Tfh, pattern = "^Rp[sl]")
seurat.Tfh[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.Tfh, pattern = "^Hb")

VlnPlot(seurat.Tfh, group.by = "orig.ident",
        features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "nCount_ADT", "percent.mt", "percent.hb"),
        ncol = 5, pt.size = 0, cols = color_vector_samples)
```

```{r qc-features, fig.width = 12, fig.cap = "Number of detected genes; line = threshold (800)."}
p1 <- seurat.Tfh@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = nFeature_RNA, fill = orig.ident)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 100) +
  xlim(c(0, 7500)) + ylim(c(0, 5000)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 800) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_vector_samples)

p2 <- VlnPlot(seurat.Tfh, group.by = "orig.ident", features = "nFeature_RNA", pt.size = 0,
              cols = color_vector_samples) +
  ylim(c(0, 7500)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 800)

cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, labels = c("A", "B"))
```

```{r qc-mito, fig.width = 12, fig.cap = "Mitochondrial gene content; line = threshold (10 %)."}
p1 <- seurat.Tfh@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = percent.mt, fill = orig.ident)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  xlim(c(0, 20)) + ylim(c(0, 11000)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_vector_samples)

p2 <- VlnPlot(seurat.Tfh, group.by = "orig.ident", features = "percent.mt", pt.size = 0,
              cols = color_vector_samples) +
  ylim(c(0, 50)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 10)

cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, labels = c("A", "B"))
```

## Filtering

Cells are kept with > 800 detected genes, < 10 % mitochondrial and < 0.05 % haemoglobin reads.
No upper threshold on genes/counts, because activated cells can have a higher gene content.

```{r filtering}
seurat.Tfh.filtered <- subset(seurat.Tfh, subset = nFeature_RNA > 800 &
                                percent.mt < 10 &
                                percent.hb < 0.05)
rm(seurat.Tfh)

table(seurat.Tfh.filtered$orig.ident)
```

```{r qc-after-filtering, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "QC metrics after filtering."}
VlnPlot(seurat.Tfh.filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "nCount_ADT"),
        ncol = 4, pt.size = 0, cols = color_vector_samples)
```

# Sample integration

Without integration the cells cluster by sampling day. Samples are therefore log-normalised separately
(2,000 variable genes each) and integrated with Seurat anchors (`FindIntegrationAnchors`, `IntegrateData`).

```{r integration}
if (recalculate_integration == 1) {
  split_seurat <- SplitObject(seurat.Tfh.filtered, split.by = "orig.ident")

  split_seurat <- lapply(split_seurat, function(x) {
    x <- NormalizeData(x)
    FindVariableFeatures(x, nfeatures = 2000)
  })

  features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = split_seurat)
  anchors  <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = split_seurat, anchor.features = features)

  seurat.integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors)
  DefaultAssay(seurat.integrated) <- "integrated"
  saveRDS(seurat.integrated, file = paste0(rdata, "RDS_integrated_Seurat_", project, ".rds"))
} else {
  seurat.integrated <- readRDS(file = paste0(rdata, "RDS_integrated_Seurat_", project, ".rds"))
}
rm(seurat.Tfh.filtered)
```

# Export for doublet detection

```{r export-sce}
DefaultAssay(seurat.integrated) <- "RNA"
tfh.sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seurat.integrated)
save(tfh.sce, file = paste0(rdata, "RDS_integrated_Seurat_SCE_", project, ".RData"))
```
